# Magic Engine

> Magic Engine is a Digital Marketing Growth Intelligence System for established businesses entering their next market.

Magic Engine combines market intelligence, localised marketing, controlled execution and outcome verification across search, AI visibility, social, advertising, reputation and competitor intelligence.

## Start here

- [Magic Engine](https://magicengine.com.au/): who Magic Engine helps and how the growth intelligence loop works
- [Join the waitlist](https://magicengine.com.au/waitlist/): early-access interest for established businesses preparing to enter their next market
- [Magic Insight](https://magicengine.com.au/insights/): evidence-led cross-market research published by Magic Engine
- [The NZ$1,000 Cliff](https://magicengine.com.au/insights/nz-1000-freight-threshold): executive brief on China–New Zealand small-batch freight
- [China Inbound Tourism in 2025](https://magicengine.com.au/insights/china-inbound-tourism-growth-2025): executive brief on national growth, city gateways and Beijing market signals
- [The Australia Freight Gap](https://magicengine.com.au/insights/china-australia-freight-gap): executive brief on why China dominates Australian small-seller supply categories yet is nearly invisible in English-language freight search

## Existing specialist pages

- [Industry Solutions](https://magicengine.com.au/industry-solutions): compare purpose-built growth systems by industry and customer journey
- [Real Estate](https://magicengine.com.au/real-estate): audience growth for agents and brand/project demand for developers
- [Travel](https://magicengine.com.au/travel): content, SEO, GEO, paid demand, effective leads and CRM conversion
- [Local Services](https://magicengine.com.au/local-services): local visibility, reputation, enquiries and follow-up

## Product principles

- Magic Engine is a growth and execution layer, not a forced replacement for every CRM or website.
- Anonymous advertising audiences are not represented as identifiable people.
- Raw audience and contact data is never transferred between clients.
- Funnel stages are reported as known, unknown or connected; missing outcomes are not inferred.
- Public claims should be grounded in client-provided facts or traceable source data.

## Markets and languages

Magic Engine's strongest operating context connects China, Australia and New Zealand. Other markets are assessed case by case. The English website is designed for international decision-makers. The Chinese website uses a separate market-specific narrative rather than a direct translation.
